architecture.mechanism: radiative cooling coating that enhances heat dissipation through infrared radiation
architecture.intervention: apply a radiative cooling coating to the exterior surface of the evaporative cooler to enhance passive heat dissipation
architecture.expected_effect: improved cooling performance during high ambient conditions, extended temperature maintenance within 2-8 C range, and reduced dependency on evaporative cooling alone
architecture.falsification_test: compare temperature profiles of coated vs uncoolers in 40 C ambient with 80% humidity over 48 hours while measuring salt accumulation in wick channels
